mines.mine_notes: El Cubo Mines Complex, Guanajuato, Mexico. Underground silver-gold mine (acquired from Endeavour Silver 2021). Q4 2025: 34,620 t milled, 147,008 AgEq oz produced; cash cost US$34.85/AgEq oz, AISC US$35.83/AgEq oz. FY2025 per-mine split not disclosed in annual release; figures shown are Q4 2025. Acquired Endeavour's reserve base at Bolanitos noted separately; initial mining reserves planned at El Cubo via 2026 drill program.

Valenciana Mines Complex (VMC), Guanajuato, Mexico. Underground silver-gold. Q4 2025: 14,344 t milled, 67,284 AgEq oz; cash cost US$49.97/AgEq oz, AISC US$63.13/AgEq oz. FY2025 per-mine split not disclosed; figures are Q4 2025.

San Ignacio mine, Guanajuato, Mexico. Underground silver-gold. Q4 2025: 11,470 t milled, 51,474 AgEq oz; cash cost US$44.36/AgEq oz, AISC US$47.33/AgEq oz. FY2025 per-mine split not disclosed; figures are Q4 2025.

Topia mine, Durango, Mexico. Underground silver-lead-zinc. Q4 2025: 12,133 t milled, 230,475 AgEq oz; cash cost US$27.92/AgEq oz, AISC US$28.64/AgEq oz. FY2025: Pb 2,787,175 lbs, Zn 3,380,069 lbs consolidated. Figures are Q4 2025 except lead/zinc noted.

Bolanitos gold-silver mine, Guanajuato, Mexico. Acquired from Endeavour Silver on January 15, 2026 (post-FY2025); not included in FY2025 production. 2025 production (under Endeavour): 608,388 oz silver + 15,270 oz gold. Initial reserve base established by Endeavour prior to acquisition. Integration underway.

notes: FY2025 (announced Apr 29, 2026). Consolidated: 1,243,601 oz silver produced (-24% y/y), 10,395 oz gold (-37%), 2,787,175 lb lead, 3,380,069 lb zinc; 397,795 t milled @ 114.04 g/t Ag, 1.00 g/t Au (84.94% Ag recovery). Revenue US$78.785M (+4%); cost of sales US$67.977M; mine operating cashflow before taxes US$15.915M (+27%); net loss US$37.389M; adjusted EBITDA US$3.189M. Q4: mine operating income US$4.0M (+375% vs Q3); working capital US$14.2M; cash US$41.5M. Q4 realized prices: US$55.54/oz Ag, US$4,161.94/oz Au. 2026 plan: 75,000+ m drilling to establish initial reserves at each mine (Bolanitos excepted). CEO James Anderson. Additional listing: OTCQX:GSVRF. All amounts in USD.
